entities.summary: Juan de Esquivel, a notable figure in the history of Jamaica, associated with Spanish Colonial Period (1494–1540). Preceded by Columbus arrives at Jamaica — May 5, 1494. Their legacy influenced Juan de Esquivel founds Sevilla la Nueva 1509 and Capital moved to Santiago de la Vega (Spanish Town) c. 1534.
